annotations.text:
Mobile-first: the three phone artboards are the primary design; desktop is the same board widened, not a separate one.

Read-only board, exactly one mutating action — Approve, behind a confirm sheet that shows the spend ceiling.

Five columns, each derived from state that already exists:

Backlog = [ ] rows in P1>P2>P3 order (this IS --queue's order)
Needs review = a plan with no run envelope
In progress = [~] rows + non-terminal runs, showing current stage
Paused = status: paused
Recently done = [x] rows

The board invents no status of its own.

Palette carried over from the toolkit architecture map — the same CVD-validated hues, reused as column identity:

blue = flow / running
violet = gates / decisions
amber = attention
teal = written / done

Identity is never colour alone: every column is labelled.
